acceptance.output_evidence: Q1: the page holds no holdings rows (TicketCenter keeps the file bytes, the token and the finding words only: TicketCenter.tsx:228, analysisRequest.ts:253-261); the response wire carries template.rows on NEEDS_CORRECTION (uploads.py:494-497) but the rows hold only row, symbol, amount, basis and cells A and B (template_reader.py:451-452). Unresolved codes: TICKER_NOT_FOUND, TICKER_DATA_NOT_ENTITLED, TICKER_AMBIGUOUS, TICKER_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE, TICKER_CHECK_FAILED, TICKER_NOT_CHECKED, TICKER_KEPT_BY_HISTORY (uploads.py:65-134; portfolio.py:501-571). Q2: the catalogue entry is key, label, ticker, name_source; no CUSIP or ISIN; the universe is 5 model entries plus named etf-classifications tickers; exact id match impossible (ComparisonCatalogue.schema.json:29; comparison_catalogue.py:116, 147-159). Q3: no per-holding row list on the analysis form; no per-holding member on the submit (AnalysisSubmissionRequest.schema.json:7); the acceptance path is a corrections re-post on the upload (AnalysisUploadRequest.schema.json:65; prospect.ts withCorrections). Q4: PORTAL_ONLY for the display, the accept and the swap suppression; BACKEND for the Keep clause, because TICKER_NOT_FOUND is ERROR and any ERROR keeps the upload NEEDS_CORRECTION (portfolio.py:440, 578). Absences stated with the search: UNRESOLVED and UNKNOWN finding codes not emitted; NOT_FOUND only a refusal reason (uploads.py:50) and a provider state (security_resolution.py:16); no per-holding table in the Ticket Center analysis form (TicketCenter.tsx:612 and 768 are ticket lists).
acceptance.denominator: 4 of 4 questions answered with cites; 1 recommendation (BACKEND_AND_PORTAL); 4 absences stated with the search that found none; 94 of 94 cites re-opened by cite_check.py. Output recorded; no verdict.
